title: Lightweight onboarding validator and pin-orchestration for verified runtime profiles
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Problem: The current verified performance profile publish flow requires heavy full-run benchmarks and manual signoffs for each model version, causing backlog and stale profiles. Goal: Build a lightweight onboarding validator and pin-orchestration flow that produces Redwood-verified profiles for common model families faster (sampled latency/throughput/cost signatures), integrates with existing runtime anchors, and supports automated pin suggestions with human review gates. This ticket scopes the PM orchestration, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and ops handoff for the engineering work in ENG-64210/ENG-65122.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Validator runs a sampled production-shadow harness and emits a compact performance signature within 6 hours for medium-sized models (<=7B). 2) Profiles published by the validator include: p50/p95 generation latency, steady-state throughput at 16-token step, and cost-per-1000-tokens normalized to hw anchor. 3) Console shows suggested pin decision (pin / pin-to-variant / no-pin) with rationale and confidence score. 4) All published profiles are signed and recorded in catalog with provenance metadata and automated rollback hook. 5) End-to-end publish (validator -> sign -> catalog) completes without manual steps in 95% of trials in staging.
tasks: Draft validator scoring rubric and confidence thresholds
Define compact profile JSON schema and provenance fields
Design console UI for suggested pins and review flow
Implement automated signing and append-only ledger (ENG-65122)
Write rollout playbook and rollback triggers
Create synthetic smoke-suite for validator correctness
notes: Prefer sampled shadow-run over full benchmarks to reduce cost for initial validation
Normalize cost signals against the runtime anchor HW profile (see runtime-anchors doc) to make cross-hardware comparison meaningful
This flow targets common open model families first (LlamaX, RedM, OpenLM-*); rarer/large models will still use full onboarding pipeline initially
progress_updates: 2025-01-17: Kickoff with ENG and Design. Agreed on three-tier confidence labels (High/Medium/Low).
2025-01-24: ENG prototyped sampling harness; produced first compact signature for a 6B model (p50 78ms, p95 210ms, cost $0.008/1k tokens normalized).
2025-02-03: Design provided UI mockups for suggested pin review + explainability tooltip. UX requests quick access to sample traces and failure histograms.
2025-02-10: Security flagged provenance ledger format; ENG-65122 updated to include signed attestations and immutable storage (S3 + digest verify).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sampled runs may miss tail latencies on bursty workloads -> Mitigation: require periodic full-run refresh for profiles that show high variance
Risk: Auto-suggested pins could be incorrect -> Mitigation: Safety-first default is 'suggest' not 'auto-apply'; require PM signoff for P0 customers
Risk: Cost normalization drift across HW types -> Mitigation: include anchor-check snapshot and decay window in profile metadata
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): run validator in parallel to full pipeline for 2 weeks and measure false-positive/false-negative rate. Phase 2 (canary): enable suggested pins for internal teams and allow manual apply. Phase 3: opt-in external customers and monitor pin adoption. Phase 4: enable auto-apply for low-risk model families with high-confidence validator scores.
metrics_and_sla: Primary metrics: time-to-first-signature (target <6h), validator confidence calibration (calibration error <0.08), profile staleness (median refresh interval >30 days). Operational targets: end-to-end publish success rate >=95% in staging, rollback latency <10m.
release_notes: Adds a lightweight validator and pin suggestion flow for faster verified profile publishing. Initial rollout limited to medium-sized models and staging; includes console UI for suggested pins and signed provenance ledger.
handoff: After engineering completes feature, PM will run 2-week staging audit with SRE and Internal Apps; product will produce an operator runbook and training session for Solutions Engineering.
